Mem_ExplainerTitle: AMD AM4 / MSI Click BIOS Memory Timings Architecture
Mem_ExplainerBody:
On AMD AM4 motherboards (e.g. MSI B550), timing control is divided into 3 independent tiers:
• Tier 1 (AMD CBS, AmdSetup): Hardware AGESA registers in hex format (10h Clk = 16, 12h = 18, 26h = 38). When MSI overlay is 0 (Auto), the CPU applies these directly.
• Tier 2 (MSI Click BIOS OC Engine, Setup): OEM manual overlay (0 = Auto). Non-zero values override CBS registers during early POST via MSI's PEI driver.
• Tier 3 (AMD Overclocking PBS): Auxiliary duplicate menu (Auto by default).
Mem_Tier1Desc: Hardware AGESA hexadecimal registers (10h Clk = 16, 12h = 18, 26h = 38). Applied directly by CPU when MSI overlay is set to 0.
